race.title: Gaeil Colmcille GAA Kells 'Day At The Races' Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
race.verdict: MR CAULFIELD would have won but for a late fall at Carlisle on Monday, and he can gain compensation. Sheer Raz , Annarubyrose and Mary's Pride all look plausible each-way angles in this big-field handicap. MR CAULFIELD (IRE) SHEER RAZ (IRE) ANNARUBYROSE (IRE)
